ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution with a contrast ratio heavily skewed towards black/dark grey values (>95%); high-intensity white pixels are limited to localized clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-toned pigmentation across the primary ventral surface; distinct high-contrast white circular clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and significant vertical indentation depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire superior trailing boundary; profile consists of jagged peaks and troughs of varying pixel amplitude, particularly dense on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes; the trailing edge trajectory curves from the central notch toward the distal tips with a high degree of symmetry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast circular white spots concentrated on the peripheral margins and tips of both lobes, representing localized scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple depigmented circular marks and irregular trailing edge textures on the distal-most portions of the fluke lobes.
